title: Tesla posts record Q2 deliveries, boosting growth hopes
title_zh: 特斯拉第二季度交付量创历史新高，提振增长希望
summary: STORY: Tesla posted record second-quarter deliveries on Thursday.The automaker beat Wall Street estimates and boosted hopes that it could end its two-year streak of annual sales declines.The company delivered more than 480,000 vehicles between April and June, up about 25% from...
summary_zh: 故事：特斯拉周四发布了创纪录的第二季度交付量。这家汽车制造商超出了华尔街的预期，并增强了人们对其结束两年连续年度销量下滑的希望。该公司在 4 月至 6 月期间交付了超过 48 万辆汽车，较之增长约 25%。

title: Chip Industry Urges US to Avoid Moves That Distort Memory Market
title_zh: 芯片行业敦促美国避免扭曲内存市场的举动
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Government attempts to address the global memory chip shortage by influencing prices or production capacity would worsen a historic squeeze on supply driven by the artificial intelligence boom, a semiconductor industry group warned the Trump administration.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——一个半导体行业组织警告特朗普政府，政府试图通过影响价格或产能来解决全球存储芯片短缺问题，这将加剧人工智能热潮推动的历史性供应紧张。

title: June jobs report misses expectations: What it means for the economy
title_zh: 六月就业报告未达预期：这对经济意味着什么
summary: The US labor market added just 57,000 jobs in June, below expectations. Morning Brief Host Brooke DiPalma welcomes Business Insider Today Executive Editor and Anchor Dan DeFrancesco to break down the report and what it means for the economy.
summary_zh: 6 月份美国劳动力市场仅新增 57,000 个就业岗位，低于预期。早间简报主持人布鲁克·迪帕尔玛欢迎《今日商业内幕》执行主编兼主持人丹·德弗朗西斯科详细分析该报告及其对经济的意义。
